name: TheoHealth
desc: Turning everyday stories into better care.
body: Co-founded TheoHealth, a conversational medical diary that turns patient narratives into structured clinical data. Helped secure enough startup funding to get the venture started, find mentors, and lead the startup’s AI strategy. Led a 10-person team, refined the experience through 40+ user surveys, and established physician partnerships for pilot testing. I have since stepped away from the team.
label: AI extraction accuracy

name: Gotham AI
desc: Three personas. One very capable assistant.
body: Built an assistant with three Batman-universe personas, custom voices, biometric authentication, real-time vision, and five mini-games. Combined RAG, function calling, and streaming for responsive interactions. Added Council Mode for parallel responses from all three personas, cinematic intros, and more than 15 Easter eggs.
label: voice-distinct personas

name: BLACKOUT
desc: Exploring what happens when the grid goes dark.
body: Built BLACKOUT with a team for the AEP sponsor challenge at Hack OHI/O 2025. The prototype calculates weather-dependent line ratings using IEEE 738, visualizes grid stress, simulates outages with N-1 contingency analysis, and explores 24-hour load scenarios. A Claude-powered conversational assistant helps transmission planners query the grid data.
label: Hack OHI/O 2025
tech: React · TypeScript · Python / Flask · PyPSA · Plotly · Claude · RAG

name: AutoPatt
desc: Precision at a very different scale.
body: Built a semiconductor tracking system using OpenCV and Arduino-controlled servos to automate detection and rotation with approximately 99% accuracy. The early Intel hackathon prototype is public; the later project repository is private.
label: tracking accuracy
award: 1st · Intel Hack OHI/O / 2nd · OSU Tech Showcase

name: AdviseBot
desc: A clearer path through academic advising.
body: Built an AI-driven virtual academic advisor to improve the OSU advisory workflow, achieving a 40% improvement in efficiency.
label: workflow efficiency improvement
